[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Spiral matrix** [LC 54 · Spiral Matrix](https://leetcode.com/problems/spiral-matrix/){difficulty="Medium"}

A spiral is a walk with one rule: go straight until the next step would leave the matrix or land on a cell already read, then turn clockwise. The only subtle moment is when the unread part has shrunk to a single row or column, where a walk that checks only "am I still inside the walls" reads that strip twice.

[Solved in full in @sec-mat-p1-spiral.]{.card-link}
